content.short: Charged Particles is a protocol that enables users to deposit digital assets into any NFT, creating interest-bearing and nested NFT bundles.
content.description: Charged Particles is an innovative NFT protocol that allows every NFT to act as a container for other digital assets, including ERC-20, ERC-721, and ERC-1155 tokens. This technology enables the creation of 'Nested NFTs' that can have intrinsic value, carry time-locked rewards, or represent complex financial bundles. On the Mantle Network, Charged Particles provides a powerful foundation for building advanced NFT-based gaming and DeFi applications with high capital efficiency.
content.meta: Charged Particles is a protocol for nested and interest-bearing NFTs on the Mantle Network. Discover Charged Particles on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
